blocks.text: Rigid Box Manufacturer in Vietnam

Jinhao Xinyuan Group is a dedicated rigid box manufacturer with factories in Vietnam (Bac Ninh) and China (Dongguan). We produce custom OEM rigid boxes — two-piece lid-and-base, magnetic-closure, drawer, book-style, and collapsible — for premium retail, luxury gifting, cosmetics, jewelry, electronics, and export programs.

All rigid box production runs on FSC®-certified greyboard, ISO 9001 quality systems, SMETA-audited social compliance, and G7®-calibrated color management. Pantone-match printing, Low MOQ from 500 units, and lead times of 18–25 days for standard configurations.
Rigid Box Types We Manufacture
Two-Piece Lid & Base Rigid Boxes

Classic separate-lid construction with reinforced greyboard walls (2.0–3.0 mm). The default rigid box for premium retail packaging — apparel, accessories, gift sets, corporate gifting. Available with rolled-edge or sharp-corner finishing, foam or fabric inserts.
Magnetic-Closure Rigid Boxes
Hidden neodymium magnets in the lid and base for a clean, premium opening experience. Used widely for cosmetics, fragrance sets, watches, and electronics. Custom inserts and reveal flaps available.
Drawer (Slide-Out) Rigid Boxes
Slide-out tray construction with a printed outer sleeve. Popular for chocolates, jewelry, and pen sets. Drawer pull options: ribbon, finger-cut, or matched-paper tab.
Book-Style Rigid Boxes
Hinged-lid rigid boxes that open like a book — used for premium photo albums, perfume sets, and luxury sample kits. Magnetic or ribbon closure options.
Collapsible (Flat-Pack) Rigid Boxes

Flat-shipped rigid boxes that fold into a finished rigid structure at the warehouse — reducing inbound freight volume by 60–80% versus pre-assembled rigid. Magnetic side panels lock the box into shape. Ideal for e-commerce gifting programs and international export.

blocks.text: Materials & Construction

Rigid box cores use greyboard thicknesses from 1.5 mm (small jewelry / accessory boxes) to 3.0 mm (oversized retail and hampers). Paper wraps include art paper, soft-touch laminate, kraft, textured specialty papers, and fabric veneers (linen, velvet).

Finishing options: hot foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, soft-touch matte, gloss laminate, edge-painting, and ribbon trims. Structural CAD development ensures precise panel alignment, corner stability, and long-term load durability.
Sustainability & Certifications

FSC®-certified greyboard, recycled paper wrap options, water-based inks, and low-VOC coatings available across our rigid box range. ISO 9001 quality management and SMETA-audited social compliance at both Vietnam and China sites. ISTA-compliant transit testing on request.
Why Choose Jinhao Xinyuan for Rigid Boxes

Dedicated rigid-box production lines at our Bac Ninh (Vietnam) and Dongguan (China) factories. Low MOQ from 500 units. Pantone-match color matching with G7® calibration. Structural CAD prototyping included. Lead time 18–25 days for standard configurations, 25–35 days for complex finishing.

For oversized rigid boxes — hampers, apparel sets, and large promotional kits — see our dedicated /large-gift-boxes/ page. For collapsible rigid for e-commerce, see /collapsible-gift-boxes-for-e-commerce-retail/.
Get a Rigid Box Quote

Send us your rigid box specification — dimensions, materials, finishing, MOQ, target lead time — and our engineering team will return a structural drawing, prototype timeline, and per-unit quotation within 24–48 hours. Contact us via the form on /contact-us/ or email info@jinhaoxy.com.
